design: research 2026-11-23/r3/lab-keystone/002-007: A-A at rest, centre (5,5), r0 in {4,5,6} x {H,V}, T = 1.0, sample_dt 0.0025, tracker only
law_under_test: P-0024 relative acceleration G/q^P, G = 23.63, P = 2.099 (1D projected separation on the initial axis)
pass_rule: P-0024 extends to r0 4-6 for t <= 1 if the pooled residual rms of M1 is <= 0.09 on the projected separation (noise 0.071, allowing model slack) and no run's residual drifts past t = 0.5 by more than 0.1. Otherwise M1 is rejected at t <= 1 too and the claim is narrowed to r0 <= 3.
discriminator: Effective relative acceleration at r0 = 5: M1 gives 0.81, the T = 2 fits give about 0.66. Measurement precision per run is expected to be a few percent; a 0.66 result would reject M1 at r0 = 5 with the T = 1 data alone.
grant_request: 2026-11-23/r3/lab-keystone/001: 16 A, 8 pairs, T = 0.3. Full additive M1 model over all 120 pairs is saved in grant_prereg_prediction_2026-11-23.json. Pairs at r > 3 contribute up to about 0.18 of displacement at T = 0.3, so a pass tests additivity and M1 at r = 3-10 jointly. A fail cannot be attributed without the r0 = 4-6 runs above.
